title: Model Context Protocol Python SDK: OAuth client could send credentials to an authorization server chosen by the MCP…
description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) Python SDK versions 1.9.1 through 1.29.1 and 2.0.0 through 2.1.1 contain a vulnerability in their OAuth client implementation. The SDK does not properly validate the authorization server issuer metadata and does not bind stored client credentials to a specific authorization server. This allows a malicious or compromised MCP server to redirect OAuth credentials to an attacker-controlled authorization server, potentially exposing client secrets and authorization codes. The issue affects OAuth clients using certain providers and connecting to untrusted MCP servers. Fixed in versions 1.30.0 and 2.2.0, the fix includes strict issuer validation and credential binding. Users should upgrade and rotate credentials if exposure is suspected.
